subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw add a public native subagent completion-routing contract named `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"`, and should that contract be available both per-spawn and as `agents.defaults.subagents.announceTarget`?
rationale: The requested behavior is a new model-facing tool/config API that changes how completion events wake parent sessions and whether output reaches the external channel, which is a compatibility-sensitive product choice under the repository config-surface policy.

options.title: Approve per-spawn plus config default
options.body: Add `announceTarget` to `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, default it to current channel behavior, and route `parent` completions into the requester session without direct channel delivery.

options.title: Approve per-spawn only
options.body: Add only a per-call override to avoid expanding global config while still enabling explicit orchestrator-controlled handoffs.

options.title: Decline native routing for now
options.body: Keep current depth-based completion delivery and leave users on explicit callback patterns or narrower follow-up issues.

recommendation.title: Approve per-spawn plus config default
recommendation.body: Add `announceTarget` to `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, default it to current channel behavior, and route `parent` completions into the requester session without direct channel delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced `sessions_spawn`, has the densest recent ownership across the subagent announce path, and authored the latest contract-restoration pass.
